list: 55 official PS5 trophies · names, descriptions and grades mirrored from PSN

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use this as the final audit rather than another activity. Earn all 54 other single-player trophies; no GTA Online or DLC work belongs to this list. A Long Road must already show 100% Completion. If the platinum stays locked, compare the console list with this tracker by kind and grade to find the gap.
trophies.progressCheck: 54/54 other base-game trophies unlocked. The console trophy list is the final proof.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Earlier work is retained. The checklist is selective, not literally everything: major targets include 100 optional tasks, all 39 gang operations, all 8 vaults, 42 range golds, all 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70/80 challenges and 15 Target Decks. Also scan 200 base-model vehicles and study 100 animals. Nothing on this checklist is missable.
trophies.progressCheck: The in-game 100% display is the only completion proof; this app’s 55 ticks are a different ledger.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, check Jason’s kitchen in the morning. Follow Lucia to the balcony and Accept her meditation invitation before Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx confirms this interaction disappears, adds +1 to the 18-meditation total, but has not proved whether the trophy requires it—treat it as required and keep a chapter save.

There are 18 meditations across 10 spots. Visit with Jason and Lucia together for +2 per spot after Coffee Break. Track Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The final Ascent Mountain marker appears after the others; A Long Road needs only 15/18, this trophy needs the full set.
trophies.progressCheck: 18/18 meditations, including the Chapter 1 balcony session as insurance. Window: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, before Chapter 2.
